direction.text: Ada should be in the pond hall by now and the others are waiting. Walk there now, please. Do not say it yet; wait until I write "your turn". Keep it cheap: do just this with one or two commands, no exploring, then wait for my next message.
direction.reason: straggler: not in the pond hall 120 s after the last direction (nudge 1/2)
direction.speaker: ada
